correctness.rationale: The forbidden-factor conditions are hereditary under taking factors. On appending one bit, any new forbidden factor must be a suffix. For each suffix length m, either verify 10 equal contiguous blocks or 4 distinct contiguous blocks, so prefix BFS is exhaustive. A freshly coded, separate independent suffix-check implementation enumerated all lengths 0 through 42: survivor counts at 32..42 equal (40,34,30,26,18,14,10,6,4,2,0) and at 41 returns exactly the two displayed strings. Inspected source verify.py implements an additional every-factor rescanning engine and compares every complete level, and its certificate states the same exact strings. Complement and reversal checks hold by direct comparison. Thus this is a finite exhaustive proof, not inference from Riasat threshold alone.
residual_risks: Enumerative classification is for a single finite boundary (k=10,r=4); no all-k structural theorem follows.
Source double-engine is not algorithmically independent in every detail, but independent new prefix implementation reproduced exact final levels.

value.rationale: A complete equality classification immediately below an independently published exact Ramsey-type unavoidability threshold is a natural exact finite extremal object. The exceptional k=10 case lies just before the k>=11 4k pattern, and two complementary palindromic maximizers give nontrivial rigidity information unavailable from N(10,4)=42 alone. Modest finite fact, not falsely presented as a general theorem or broad breakthrough.
residual_risks: Narrow one-parameter extremal layer, with limited implications for general N(k,r) and conjecture at k>=11.

final_claim: At the already-known binary k-power/r-antipower threshold N(10,4)=42, there are exactly two length-41 binary words avoiding both 10-powers and 4-antipowers: 00101010101010101010001010101010101010100 and its bitwise complement 11010101010101010101110101010101010101011. Both are palindromes; no length-42 avoider exists.
limitations: Best-of-knowledge originality, with explicit source inspections, mathematical comparisons and residual risks; no independent external attestation or formal mechanized proof claimed.
The science is privately assessed but publication is withheld because unchanged package metadata contain internal operational provenance identifiers; no GitHub write, research import or publication.
